contents.description: Diagnostic Anglais 1ere : Les temps du présent

questions.question: Choose the correct tense: 'She ___ (work) at the hospital every morning.'
'I am not understanding this lesson' is a grammatically correct sentence in English.
Explique la différence de sens entre ces deux phrases : 'I read a lot.' / 'I am reading a book about history.'
Which sentence correctly uses the present perfect?
choices: I have seen that film yesterday.
She has already finished her homework.
They have went to Paris last summer.
He has work here since ten years.

questions.question: The present perfect can be used to talk about life experiences without specifying when they happened.
Complète avec le bon temps (present simple, continuous ou perfect) : 'Look! The cat ___ (sleep) on the sofa again.'
Choose the correct sentence using 'for' or 'since' with the present perfect.
choices: She has lived here since three years.
She has lived here for three years.
She has lived here since three years ago.

questions.question: The sentence 'Water boils at 100 degrees' uses the present simple correctly to express a scientific fact.

exercisenotion.description: Le present simple exprime des habitudes, des vérités générales, des faits permanents et des horaires fixes. Marqueurs : always, usually, often, sometimes, never, every day. Ex : She works at a hospital. / Water boils at 100°C.

Le present continuous exprime une action en cours au moment où l'on parle, une action temporaire, ou un futur proche planifié. Marqueurs : now, at the moment, currently, look!, listen!. Ex : He is reading a book right now. / They are moving to Paris next month.

Le present perfect relie le passé au présent. Il exprime une expérience de vie, un résultat présent d'une action passée, ou une action récente. Marqueurs : ever, never, already, yet, just, recently, since, for. Ex : I have just finished my homework. / She has lived here for five years.
